Interface MissingKeyPolicy

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface MissingKeyPolicy
Decides what Bundle.format(Locale, String, Map) returns when no locale in the fallback chain defines the requested message.

    • logOnce

      static MissingKeyPolicy logOnce(MissingKeyPolicy delegate)
      Logs each missing key once, then delegates.

      At most 512 distinct keys are remembered; later misses are delegated silently.
